newsitem.title: UK: HSBC to buy Eversholt for 1.0 bln stg-paper.
newsitem.headline: HSBC to buy Eversholt for 1.0 bln stg-paper.

text.p: A subsidiary of banking group HSBC Holdings will buy train leasing company Eversholt for nearly one billion pounds ($1.64 billion), a British newspaper said on Monday.
The Daily Telegraph said Forward Trust, HSBC's leasing subsidiary, would complete the deal this week after nearly three months of negotiations.
Eversholt is controlled by seven venture capital groups, led by Candover Partners, the paper said.
The deal was expected to involve HSBC issuing securitised bonds, it said. ($1=.6097 Stg)
